pipeline_proposal.description: Determine what each shop option modifies before adding it to food identity.
pipeline_proposal.payload_json: {"text":"Before constructing a Food path from explicit original shop options, excluding placeholders, use each option's name and compatible title/description evidence to identify the item each modifier describes: represent food flavour or colour at variant level and food format or form as distinct product identity, keep quantity and accessory properties outside the food identity path, and leave modifiers with unresolved referents unassigned."}
pipeline_proposal.rationale: The supplied validator adds a promotional bag's colour to a food variant and treats whole-bean form as a variant. Binding options to their referents targets these semantic errors without relying on exact-label mismatches. This is an untested development proposal.

pipeline_proposal.description: Replace maker-required parking with an assessment of affirmative marketed-brand evidence.
pipeline_proposal.payload_json: {"text":"For Food brand resolution, replace the requirement for maker evidence with a consumer-facing brand assessment: explicit official-shop provenance combined with affirmative first-person attribution of the item as the shop's own product may support the shop's unambiguous marketed mark, corroborated by its supplied seller/vendor identity. Seller/vendor roles or source slugs alone remain insufficient; preserve conflicting marketed-brand evidence and park when attribution remains ambiguous. Missing brand or maker fields are absence of evidence, not evidence of shop own-label."}
pipeline_proposal.rationale: Repeated development abstentions apply a maker requirement to brand resolution. This introduces a conditional first-party attribution mechanism without automatically promoting vendors, inventing aliases, or treating gold labels as source evidence.

pipeline_proposal.description: Remove the whole phrase 'variety pack' from quantity vocabulary so its assortment meaning survives parsing.
pipeline_proposal.rationale: Supplied source evidence distinguishes a named assortment of flavours from its serving count. Removing this compound entry preserves 'variety' for identity assessment while generic 'pack' and numeric quantities remain removable. This corrects a vocabulary conflict with the owner’s assortment convention; development gains remain unmeasured.
